```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(caret)
library(randomForest)
library(tidyverse)
library(ranger)


gene_exp <-  readRDS(file = "../Outputs/gene_exp.RData")
pt_status <-  readRDS(file = "../Outputs/pt_status.RData")

geneoutcome <- full_join(gene_exp, pt_status)

```

#Adj Rec RFE feature selection
```{r}
rec_data <- geneoutcome[, !(names(geneoutcome) %in% "Sample")] %>%
  filter(Cohort == "Adj_Exp") %>%
  filter(Reason.for.discontinuation == "Progression" | Reason.for.discontinuation == "Therapy complete") %>%
  select(-Cohort)

#separating predictors from  Reason.for.discontinuation
x_vars_rec <- rec_data[, !(names(rec_data) %in% "Reason.for.discontinuation")]
y_var_rec <- rec_data$Reason.for.discontinuation
y_var_rec <- as.factor(y_var_rec)

#define the control using random forest functions
control <- rfeControl(
  functions = rfFuncs, 
  method = "cv",  
  number = 5 
)

#run the RFE algorithm
set.seed(43201) 
rfe_results_rec <- rfe(
  x = x_vars_rec,
  y = y_var_rec,
  sizes = c(1:79),      
  rfeControl = control
)

#print summary of the feature selection process
print(rfe_results_rec)

#view the optimal subset of features chosen by the model
optimal_features <- predictors(rfe_results_rec)
print(optimal_features)


#plot performance vs. number of features
ggplot(rfe_results_rec) + 
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 18),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 18))


ggsave("../figures/rf_rec_greedygraph.png", width = 7, height = 7)


# Extract the top 13 features directly without updating the model object
features_size_13 <- rfe_results_rec$control$functions$selectVar(rfe_results_rec$variables, 13)
print(features_size_13)
```

#Adj Tox RFE feature selection
```{r}
tox_data <- geneoutcome[, !(names(geneoutcome) %in% "Sample")] %>%
  filter(Cohort == "Adj_Exp") %>%
  filter(Reason.for.discontinuation == "Toxicity" | Reason.for.discontinuation == "Therapy complete") %>%
  select(-Cohort)

#separating predictors from  Reason.for.discontinuation
x_vars_tox <- tox_data[, !(names(tox_data) %in% "Reason.for.discontinuation")]
y_var_tox <- tox_data$Reason.for.discontinuation
y_var_tox <- as.factor(y_var_tox)

#define the control using random forest functions
control <- rfeControl(
  functions = rfFuncs, 
  method = "cv",  
  number = 5   
)

#run the RFE algorithm
set.seed(43201) 
rfe_results_tox <- rfe(
  x = x_vars_tox,
  y = y_var_tox,
  sizes = c(1:79),
  rfeControl = control
)


#print summary of the feature selection process
print(rfe_results_tox$results)

#plot performance vs. number of features
ggplot(rfe_results_tox) + 
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 18),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 18))

ggsave("../figures/rf_tox_greedygraph.png", width = 7, height = 7)



#extract the top 6 features directly without updating the model object
featurestox_size_6 <- rfe_results_tox$control$functions$selectVar(rfe_results_tox$variables, 6)
print(featurestox_size_6)

```



#Adj exhaustive rec
```{r}
rec_geneoutcome <- geneoutcome %>%
    filter(Cohort == "Adj_Exp") %>%
    filter(Reason.for.discontinuation == "Therapy complete" | Reason.for.discontinuation == "Progression")

#define factors and target variable name
rec_factors <- c("YWHAZ", "UBC", "GUSB", "VTCN1", "CD276", "CD160", "CD8A",  "CD244", "PGK1",  "PVR")
target_col <- "Reason.for.discontinuation"
rec_target <- as.factor(rec_geneoutcome[[target_col]])

#generate all possible non-empty combinations of the 10 factors
allrec_subsets <- unlist(lapply(1:length(rec_factors), function(k) {
  combn(rec_factors, k, simplify = FALSE) }), recursive = FALSE)

#make data frame to store results
rec_results <- data.frame(
  Model_ID = seq_along(allrec_subsets),
  Features = sapply(allrec_subsets, paste, collapse = " + "),
  Num_Features = sapply(allrec_subsets, length),
  Performance = NA_real_
)

set.seed(43201)
for (i in seq_along(allrec_subsets)) {
  current_vars <- allrec_subsets[[i]]
  formula_str <- paste(target_col, "~", paste(current_vars, collapse = " + "))
  
  fit <- ranger(
    x = rec_geneoutcome[, current_vars, drop = FALSE],  #predictor subset
    y = rec_target,
    num.trees = 100,     
    verbose = FALSE
  )
  
  #store the OOB error 
  rec_results$Performance[i] <- fit$prediction.error
}

#view the top 20 best-performing models (lowest error)
best_models <- rec_results %>% arrange(Performance)
head(best_models, 20)
```


#Adj exhaustive tox
